assessments.name: Summative exam
assessments.description: This assessment allows students to demonstrate their knowledge and critical analysis of typical communication and swallowing development across the lifespan

assessments.name: ACE: Accelerate Communication Excellence
assessments.description: Students complete a written communication task in Week 4.

assessments.name: Early feedback quiz and reflection
assessments.description: This will help consolidate your understanding of the foundational concepts introduced so far. It aims to give you insight into your progress and provide early feedback.

assessments.name: Paired Case Study Presentation
assessments.description: Paired audio-visual presentation of your analysis of a developmental case vignette, featuring a normally developing child

assessments.name: Individual case study analysis with reflection
assessments.description: Case study analysis to demonstrate understanding of typical communication development and change across the lifespan (1600 words). Personal reflection of learning (400 words).
